description: Empirical Dataset for the Comprehensive AVSEC Decision-Support Model: Košice International Airport (2025) is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Inna Polishchuk, Marek Kurdel (Uzhhorod National University). This dataset contains aggregated operational and contextual data used for a fuzzy multi-criteria assessment of aviation security at Košice International Airport, Slovakia. It includes 40 records, primarily covering 1 January–31 December 2025; one non-model contextual record refers to March 2026. Coverage: global (SK); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
